prompt:
Create ONE stunning final Chinese premium product-brand introduction poster, high-definition native portrait 2160 x 3840 pixels if possible, highest available resolution. Apple-level launch campaign art direction: radical clean typography, luxurious luminous optical-glass pyramid monument, soft silver white space with controlled cool blue and violet refraction, deep charcoal large headline, finely crafted rounded translucent feature panels, exquisite layout and restrained cinematic light. Powerful and sophisticated, not a tutorial and not a generic template. No brand logos.
CRITICAL: The poster must NOT contain the word Codex (any capitalization), Claude, ChatGPT, AI platform names, code, commands, installation, instructions, examples, steps, URLs or QR codes. It ONLY introduces the skill and its capabilities. Use ONLY the following exact Chinese / English copy, no additional words:
Small eyebrow: “PYRAMID STUDIO”
Product name: “金字塔表达工作室”
Main large headline: “让思想，形成力量。”
Subheadline: “从零散信息，到有力论证。”
Positioning: “融合金字塔原理、结构化思考与逻辑审阅，为关键表达建立清晰的主线。”
Elegant principles line: “结论先行 · 层层支撑 · 同类归组 · 有序递进”
Feature section title: “贯通思考与表达的六大能力”
Six clear feature blocks in a balanced grid:
“观点提炼” — “穿过繁杂材料，抓住真正值得表达的判断。”
“论证构建” — “让观点、理由与证据形成相互支撑的整体。”
“专业写作” — “组织邮件、汇报与长文，让重点清楚抵达。”
“演示叙事” — “串联页面与观点，让整场表达拥有主线。”
“问题拆解” — “界定差距，梳理假设，找到验证方向。”
“逻辑审阅” — “识别支撑断点与分组问题，打磨论证结构。”
Closing big statement: “观点有锋芒，逻辑有支撑。”
Footer small statement: “尊重事实边界，让表达的力量来自内容本身。”
Use beautifully legible precise Simplified Chinese. The headline and hero pyramid command attention, feature copy is readable and not tiny, generous luxurious whitespace with sufficient information density. Full-bleed refined final artwork, sharp text and crisp crystal details. STRICTLY no Codex anywhere.
